speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for Defence whether steps have been taken or will be taken to prevent any further Malaysian Government vessels from entering the waters which Singapore has recently gazetted as part of her port limits on 6 December 2018 besides the existing Malaysian Government vessels which are currently within such waters.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Despite our disagreements, both sides want to resolve differences through discussions and peaceful means.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Our security agencies carry out their operational duties with the utmost professionalism.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will continue to do so as their presence does not strengthen Malaysia’s legal claims in any way and, indeed, as we have said before, can result in mishaps or regrettable incidents.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Singapore has welcomed assurances by the Malaysian government that they would take measures to de-escalate the tensions in STW (Tuas).

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We hope that all Malaysian agencies will abide by this stated policy.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Tensions and real risks increased during this incident.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Our Police Coast Guard and Republic of Singapore Navy vessels responded promptly to this provocation, as they had to.
